description: Port of ESLint's `max-classes-per-file` rule (https://eslint.org/docs/latest/rules/max-classes-per-file) with its default maximum of 1. Reports the file, at its first statement, when it declares or evaluates more than one class. Options are declared in the `options` define (the rule's defaults); a variant is a config patch.

cases.2: File has too many classes. Maximum allowed is 2.
File has too many classes. Maximum allowed is 2.

default.default: File has too many classes. Maximum allowed is 1.
